test: Support comparing 0/2/4 cameos as static film stills. Keep zero as the control; evaluate actual narrow/desktop GitHub sizes before choosing. Far-background Clawd/Dot, then deeper Muse/Grok, must remain optional scenery, never destinations or necessary clues.
actualBase: The inspected 3D base coherently joins dimensional scenery and soft moth forms. Foreground coder, bench and MacBook dominate; smaller workshop/resting vignettes remain secondary. Preserve graphic eyes, green wing markings and unequal antennae while adding dimension. Dense foliage already consumes background detail.
guardrail: Keep Nag attribution and project links in native text. Supply concise scene alt text without requiring recognition of tiny cameos. No hover reveal, hotspot, zoom task or motion is needed to understand GitHub. Future website meaning and navigation must remain complete with the still image.
failureCriterion: Reject a variant if cameos compete with the foreground coder at deployment size or understanding the scene requires identifying, enlarging or interacting with them.

skills.workflow: Separate scene legibility from host controls; compare deployment-size stills before interactive treatments.
skills.exception: Native GitHub excludes custom page, hover and animation recipes.

limits: Four images inspected via view_image. Cameo variants, narrow rendered application, night version, keyboard/speech/hardware and human recognition remain unverified. No unseen-art approval.
